title: Clarify constructed sourceText/name fields versus verbatim SRD text
description:
Finding source:
- Fable P4 observation: synthesized labels such as "Coinage", "Armor guidance", "Saddle, Military", "Acolyte Bonds", and choices[].sourceText like "Acolyte Personality Traits (d8)" are constructed rather than verbatim source text.
- Fable considered this not harmful for discoverability, but sourceText can be misleading as a field name.

Acceptance criteria:
- Inventory fields named sourceText/name/title that may contain generated labels.
- Rename, mark, or document constructed labels so audit/retrieval does not imply they are verbatim SRD strings.
- Record explicit non-issue rationale for any fields intentionally left unchanged.
notes: PR #391 opened: fixes incorrect verbatim doc-comment claims on CreationChoice.sourceText / optCreationChoices, adds RulesRecord.name caveat, and records non-issue rationale in a new audit note. Awaiting review/merge.
close_reason: Merged PR #391 on main (96442f4): corrected CreationChoice.sourceText / optCreationChoices doc comments that falsely claimed unconditional verbatim-ness, added RulesRecord.name importer-retitling caveat, and recorded full field inventory + non-issue rationale in docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-02-o9bd-18-8-7-constructed-label-fields.md.
